changes.fix: compare.mjs:stripDplQueryParam (new) removes only the literal `dpl` query key via URLSearchParams (other params and their relative order kept; a trailing empty `?` dropped), applied to BOTH sides at compare time inside normalizeAssetRef, before the existing hashed-/_next/static/ placeholder substitution. capture.mjs/extract.mjs are unchanged: capture still fetches the real, un-stripped URL.

changes.summary: isSameSite (extract.mjs) compared a link's host only against the CAPTURING page's own host, so a byte-identical absolute href to https://www.growmax.io/... classified as internal when captured from www.growmax.io (A) but external when captured from growmax-website.vercel.app (B).
changes.fix: extract.mjs: new exported CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_HOSTS = ['www.growmax.io','growmax.io'], shared with capture.mjs's KNOWN_HOSTS (KNOWN_HOSTS = [...CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_HOSTS, '*.vercel.app'] — the *.vercel.app wildcard stays capture-only, for redirect Location normalization, and is deliberately NOT part of same-site page-body classification). isSameSite now also treats either canonical host as same-site. Additionally, since assetRefs/internalLinks/externalLinks are baked into a manifest at capture time and the attempt-1 manifests predate this fix, compare.mjs gained reclassifyLinks() (compare time, both sides): recovers each externalLinks entry's host and moves a canonical-host href into internalLinks (as path+search), leaving third-party hosts untouched. This makes old and new manifests agree without a re-capture, mirroring bug 1's compare-time approach.

changes.area: functional/run.mjs — F9 logout (false fail / would-be false pass on a real regression)
changes.summary: F9 read `A.cookie` unchanged from F4's login and never inspected logout's own Set-Cookie. iron-session is stateless, so POST /api/admin/logout followed by GET /api/admin/session with the SAME (pre-logout) cookie still decrypts to isAdmin:true — F9 failed even though logout behaved correctly, and would have equally PASSED a regression that stopped clearing the cookie (since the old cookie would still read isAdmin:true, and the check's `body?.isAdmin === false` clause was the only thing anchoring it — coincidentally saving it here, but for the wrong reason: it depended on replay behavior, not on verifying the clear).
changes.fix: New exported checkLogout(A) (run.mjs): passes only when logout's response is 200 AND its Set-Cookie for growmax-admin actually clears the cookie AND a follow-up GET /api/admin/session reports isAdmin:false. 'Clears' means: exactly one entry whose name-value pair has an '=' and whose name, with only SP/HTAB stripped (never JS .trim(), which also strips U+00A0), is exactly growmax-admin (a pair without '=' or with an empty name never matches, RFC 6265 §5.2), in an entry a browser would accept at all (not SameSite=None or Partitioned without Secure, name+value at most 4096 octets, no CTL, fail-closed on non-ASCII, a last Domain attribute that is neither '.' (Chromium rejects `Domain=.`) nor empty after a real Domain; attribute-values over 1024 octets ignored); a valid Max-Age<=0, or without a valid Max-Age an Expires in the past parsed only by the RFC 6265 §5.1.1 cookie-date algorithm (parseCookieDate; anything it rejects, e.g. Expires=0/2020/-1, counts as no Expires); and the same effective Path, Domain and Partitioned state as the login cookie captured at F4 (fail closed without one). The follow-up GET is sent with growmax-admin=<the clearing entry's own value> in the client jar, never the stale pre-logout cookie and never an emptied jar (the earlier 'A.cookie set to null' behaviour was replaced in P6.1, see docs/migration/evidence/P6.1-f9-hardening.json): that is what a browser would hold if the harness misread the expiry, so a regression that re-sends the sealed value fails on isAdmin even then. The real app clears with an empty value (growmax-admin=; Path=/; Max-Age=0), which /api/admin/session reads as not admin. An app regression that stops clearing the cookie fails outright on clearsAdminCookie alone.

changes.summary: F2 (a real Google Chat message, capped at 3 for the whole migration) fired twice in one run because the verifier re-ran the suite while STATE.json's flags.demoTestsSent still read the old value.
changes.fix: New marker file docs/migration/.scratch/demo-tests/<runLabel>.sent (JSON: runLabel, sentAt, base — no PII), written unconditionally right after the POST /api/demo-requests is issued (in a finally, even on a non-201/throw, since the real send may already have reached the server). Before sending, F2 now refuses outright if a marker for this exact runLabel already exists (reported as skipped:true, pass:false, with the reason — never a silent pass). The cap-vs-3 check uses resolveDemoTestsSentCount(fromState, markerCount) = Math.max(...) of the caller-supplied/STATE counter and the number of .sent files on disk, so a stale STATE counter can no longer undercount.

changes.area: functional/run.mjs — F9 checkLogout could still false-pass a broken logout
changes.summary: Review round 1: checkLogout matched the admin cookie by `rawSetCookie.includes('growmax-admin=')` over Node's `headers.get('set-cookie')`, which COMMA-JOINS every Set-Cookie header into one string, and ran its Max-Age/Expires regexes over that whole joined string. Three real regressions still passed: (a) an unrelated cookie cleared (Max-Age=0) right before growmax-admin was RE-SET (Max-Age=86400, not cleared) — the substring match and whole-string regex both still fired; (b) growmax-admin genuinely cleared but under Path=/api/admin instead of the login cookie's Path=/, so a browser keeps sending the Path=/ cookie on every other request; (c) only a similarly-named `xgrowmax-admin` cookie cleared, growmax-admin itself untouched.
changes.fix: New parseCookieAttrs(entry)/isClearingCookieAttrs(attrs)/getSetCookieEntries(headers) (run.mjs): getSetCookieEntries uses `headers.getSetCookie()` (each Set-Cookie as its own entry, never the joined string), and checkLogout selects the ONE entry whose name (before '=') is EXACTLY 'growmax-admin' (ambiguous if more than one — treated as not-clearing rather than picking arbitrarily). Assertions.captureSetCookie (used by F4) now also records that login response's growmax-admin cookie's own Path/Domain onto `A.loginCookieAttrs`. checkLogout requires: exactly one growmax-admin Set-Cookie entry, that entry's own Max-Age<=0 or an expired Expires, AND its Path (default '/') and Domain (if either side sets one) match the LOGIN cookie's own Path/Domain — a clear on a different Path/Domain, or a re-set/wrong-name cookie, no longer satisfies clearsAdminCookie. isClearingSetCookie is kept (now backed by parseCookieAttrs+isClearingCookieAttrs) for the existing single-string self-test case.

changes.area: functional/run.mjs — F2 cap could still be exceeded under a stale STATE.json + a new runLabel
changes.summary: Review round 1's own simulation: STATE.json=2 (2 real historical sends, no markers on disk — the actual state of the world before this fix). resolveDemoTestsSentCount(fromState, markerCount) = Math.max(fromState, markerCount) alone: send #3 under runLabel L writes a marker (markerCount becomes 1); a re-run under a NEW runLabel L2, with STATE.json STILL stale at 2 (the orchestrator hasn't caught up yet — the entire premise of the staleness bug), recomputes max(2, 1) = 2, which is UNDER the cap of 3 and would incorrectly send #4 — with exactly one send left in the whole migration's budget, this is live risk.
changes.fix: writeDemoTestMarker now also records countBefore (the effective count resolveDemoTestsSentCount reported immediately before that send) on every marker, and is called TWICE per send: once with status:'pending' BEFORE the POST (so a process killed mid-request still leaves a marker — fail-safe, since an orphaned pending marker can only inflate a later count, never let one undercount), and once with status:'sent' after, in the same finally as before. resolveDemoTestsSentCount(fromState, markers) now takes the marker array itself (via new readDemoTestMarkers(), which parses every .sent file's JSON) and returns Math.max(fromState, markerCount, ...markers.map(m => (m.countBefore ?? 0) + 1)) — so L's own marker (countBefore:2) alone resolves to 3 regardless of what STATE.json still says, correctly refusing L2. Also added DEMO_TEST_MARKER_DIR_OVERRIDE (env, test-only): lets selftest-p5.3.mjs point every F2 case at an isolated throwaway temp directory instead of the real docs/migration/.scratch/demo-tests (addresses a review round-1 non-blocking note).

changes.area: functional/run.mjs: F9 checkLogout read cookie attributes differently from RFC 6265 and browsers
changes.summary: Review round 2 found four broken logouts that F9 still passed, all driven through the real requestJson/captureSetCookie/checkLogout: (a) a logout Set-Cookie with no Path attribute was treated as Path=/, but a browser uses the default-path of POST /api/admin/logout (/api/admin, RFC 6265 §5.1.4), so it misses the Path=/ login cookie; (b) Max-Age=86400 with a past Expires counted as a clear, but a valid Max-Age takes precedence (§5.3 step 3) and keeps the cookie for 24h; (c) an empty Max-Age= counted as a clear because Number('') is 0, but browsers ignore an invalid Max-Age; (d) with A.loginCookieAttrs null the Path/Domain check was skipped entirely.
changes.fix: parseCookieAttrs (run.mjs:69) now follows RFC 6265 §5.2: Max-Age counts only if its trimmed value matches /^-?\d+$/ (an invalid one is ignored and never overwrites an earlier valid one); Expires counts only if it parses; a Path that is empty or does not start with '/' is 'no Path'; Domain drops a leading '.', is lower-cased, and an empty one is ignored. isClearingCookieAttrs (run.mjs:122): a valid Max-Age alone decides (<=0 clears) and Expires is ignored; only without one does a past Expires clear. New cookieDefaultPath (run.mjs:96) and effectiveCookiePath (run.mjs:111) compute the RFC default-path and the Path the browser really stores the cookie under. Assertions.captureSetCookie(res, requestUrl = res.url) (run.mjs:482) records the login cookie's effectivePath (only when exactly one exact-name growmax-admin entry exists) and puts that cookie itself in the jar. checkLogout (run.mjs:541) compares logout's effective Path (from the logout request URL) with login's (run.mjs:570), and fails closed when loginCookieAttrs is null, with detail.error 'no login cookie attributes were captured ... failing closed'. The jar is only cleared when all of the above hold, so a clear a browser would ignore leaves the stale cookie in place. The real app still passes: iron-session 8.0.4 destroy() plus Next's cookie normalizer emit Path=/; Max-Age=0 (self-test 'real-app' case).

changes.area: functional/run.mjs: F2 cap fail-closed edge cases, lock, marker safety
changes.summary: Round 2 non-blocking notes: a NaN count (--demo-tests-sent two) made Math.max NaN, and NaN >= 3 is false, so F2 would send; a truncated marker counted as countBefore 0; there was no lock between two concurrent runs; DEMO_TEST_MARKER_DIR_OVERRIDE was honoured in real runs; runLabel was not sanitized before path.join; an unreadable STATE counter defaulted to 0.
changes.fix: resolveDemoTestsSentCount (run.mjs:309) returns the cap (DEMO_TEST_CAP = 3) for a non-integer or negative fromState, and counts any marker without an integer countBefore (or read back as corrupt) as the cap. readDemoTestMarkers (run.mjs:206) keeps an unparseable marker as {corrupt:true}. writeDemoTestMarker (run.mjs:255) writes atomically (tmp file + rename). New createPendingDemoTestMarker (run.mjs:269) creates the pending marker exclusively (tmp file + link(), which fails with EEXIST). The whole pre-send decision moved into exported reserveDemoTestSend (run.mjs:336, called at run.mjs:684). It checks for a duplicate label, then the cap, then creates the marker exclusively, then re-counts over every other marker. It refuses if any other marker is pending or corrupt, or if the re-count is at the cap. A higher re-count under the cap becomes this send's countBefore. On any refusal it removes its own pending marker, since nothing was POSTed. assertSafeRunLabel (run.mjs:170) rejects '', '.', '..' and labels containing '/', '\\' or NUL. main() rejects a --demo-tests-sent that is not a non-negative integer with exit 2 (run.mjs:1030). The check runs before any DB or network step. main() also exits 2 if DEMO_TEST_MARKER_DIR_OVERRIDE is set together with --allow-demo-test (run.mjs:1016). An unreadable or non-integer STATE flags.demoTestsSent now yields null, which resolves to the cap, and F2 refuses (run.mjs:973) instead of treating it as 0. F4's cookieOk (run.mjs:752) runs its attribute checks on the single exact-name growmax-admin entry, not the comma-joined header. The entry-point guard (run.mjs:1165) compares import.meta.url with pathToFileURL(realpathSync(argv[1])).href, so a path with a space or a symlink still runs main().
